description: This file contains the implementation of LogView, a custom TextView widget for displaying log messages. It implements the LogNode interface to be part of a logging chain, formatting log data and appending it to the view, with support for thread-safe UI updates.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages formatted for readability. Implements LogNode for chained logging and handles thread-safe UI updates.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for creating LogView instances with different attribute configurations.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data, including priority, tag, message, and exception, then appends it to the view asynchronously.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView.
